A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

MemberConsultation.title: MemberConsultation
MemberConsultation.description: An informal, explicitly NON-BINDING member poll (achterbanraadpleging / ledenraadpleging): a defined member audience, a governance body's active members, a fractie, or a configured Nextcloud group such as an OR's achterban, is asked a question linked to an agenda item and/or decision, and the summarised outcome flows back into the meeting as an input artifact. It is explicitly NOT a formal ballot (voting-system / preferential-ballot: never creates/feeds a VotingRound, Vote, tally or quorum) and NOT citizen input (citizen-participation / PublicConsultation: no public-group read rule, no anonymous-public intake). CONSTRAINT: at least one of agendaItem / decision MUST be set, this at-least-one-of rule is NOT expressible in the OR 'required' array (no anyOf dialect is invented here) and is enforced at save time by the imperative response/create path, documented. Every surface carries the 'niet-bindende raadpleging' label. ADR-006 addendum (consultation-discriminator, 2026-08-19): exempted from folding into PublicConsultation as a genuinely distinct concept (13% measured field overlap, no public-authorization block, x-schema-org AskAction vs. Event): see openspec/architecture/adr-006-mode-adaptation-over-parallel-entities.md.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-CCO-003). Canonical dialect verbatim (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). concept → open → gesloten → verwerkt; verwerkt terminal. Responses are only accepted while lifecycle is 'open' AND now is within opensAt–closesAt; that response-window guard is enforced server-side on every response write independent of the stored status (ConsultationResponseService) — the lifecycle dialect governs the status machine only, not the time window. No app-side state machine for the lifecycle itself.

consultationOpened._note: Audience-notified-on-open trigger (REQ-CCO-007). Fires on the transition to 'open'. LIMITATION: the notification dialect has no recipient kind that targets the server-resolved dynamic audience (active Membership set / party subset / NC group) computed by ConsultationAudienceService; object-acl(read) + the decidesk-members group is the closest declarative approximation. True per-audience delivery is a documented apply-time concern — verify against OR's notification rule engine; never an imperative dispatch path (notification-dialect gate).

consultationClosingSoon._note: Closing-soon reminder (REQ-CCO-007). intervalSec 172800 (~48h) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — griffie/bestuur-configurable tuning deferred). Filter targets lifecycle 'open' only, so no reminder fires for gesloten/verwerkt. LIMITATION (design D2): the 'recipient has not yet responded' and 'closesAt within the window' predicates are not expressible in this filter DSL; documented fallback is to notify the whole audience approximation (object-acl read + decidesk-members) rather than only non-responders — never a silent gap and never an imperative reminder BackgroundJob. Verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets the window during live import.

question.title: Question
question.description: The question put to the member audience (schema:AskAction). Required.
question.example: Steunt de fractie het raadsvoorstel Parkeervisie 2026–2030 in de huidige vorm?

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional context / toelichting shown with the question.
description.example: Niet-bindende peiling ter voorbereiding op de raadsvergadering van 12 maart.

responseType.title: Response type
responseType.description: How members respond. single-choice = exactly one option; multi-choice = one or more options; open-text = free text. Required. CONSTRAINT: choiceOptions is required when responseType is a choice type, conditional-required, not expressible in 'required', enforced at save time.

choiceOptions.title: Choice options
choiceOptions.description: The selectable options. Required when responseType is single-choice or multi-choice (conditional-required, enforced at save time); ignored for open-text.

audienceType.title: Audience type
audienceType.description: Which audience is polled. body-members = all Persons with an active Membership in audienceBody; fractie = the subset of those whose active Membership carries party = audienceParty; nc-group = the members of the Nextcloud group audienceGroup (e.g. an OR's achterban). Resolved server-side by ConsultationAudienceService; never trusted from the client. Required.

audienceBody.title: Audience body
audienceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody whose active members form the audience. REQUIRED when audienceType is body-members or fractie (conditional-required, enforced at save time). Empty for nc-group.

audienceParty.title: Audience party
audienceParty.description: Party (fractie) name matched against Membership.party within audienceBody. REQUIRED when audienceType is fractie (conditional-required, enforced at save time). Uses Membership.party today; a first-class Fractie reference is a forward-only follow-up when fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling lands (design D3).

audienceGroup.title: Audience group
audienceGroup.description: Nextcloud group id whose members form the audience (e.g. an OR's configured achterban group). REQUIRED when audienceType is nc-group (conditional-required, enforced at save time). The works-council-consultation change reuses this nc-group audience for its achterban step.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional reference to the AgendaItem this consultation prepares. At least one of agendaItem / decision MUST be set (enforced at save time). The linked agenda item's detail page reverse-looks-up this consultation for its 'Raadpleging (niet-bindend)' section.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Optional reference to the Decision this consultation prepares. At least one of agendaItem / decision MUST be set (enforced at save time). A raadpleging never feeds the formal vote on this decision.

opensAt.title: Opens at
opensAt.description: Start of the response window. Optional. Responses are only accepted while now is within opensAt–closesAt AND lifecycle is 'open'.

closesAt.title: Closes at
closesAt.description: End of the response window. Required. Enforced server-side on every response write independent of the stored lifecycle status (window-over-stale-status). Drives the closing-soon notification.

anonymousResponses.title: Anonymous responses
anonymousResponses.description: When true, no view or summary displays respondent identities (display-level anonymity, design D4). respondentId is still stored to enforce respond-once and edit-own; the UI states 'antwoorden worden niet op naam getoond' rather than promising at-rest anonymity.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Consultation status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): concept → open → gesloten → verwerkt. verwerkt is terminal. Only the initiator or staff with governance-body authority may transition it.

results.title: Results
results.description: Identity-free results summary written ONLY by the summary step on the gesloten → verwerkt transition (ConsultationSummaryService); never client-writable. Holds audience size, response count, per-option counts for choice types, and an optional initiator-curated openTextDigest for open-text. Contains no respondent identities.

audienceSize.title: Audience size
audienceSize.description: Total resolved audience size at verwerkt time.

optionCounts.title: Per-option counts
optionCounts.description: Map of choice option to response count (choice types only).

openTextDigest.title: Open-text digest
openTextDigest.description: Optional initiator-written / curated digest of the open-text answers; no identities.

MemberConsultationResponse.title: MemberConsultationResponse
MemberConsultationResponse.description: A single audience member's answer to a MemberConsultation (schema:Answer). Respond-once (at most one response per member per consultation, duplicate create by the same respondentId rejected) and edit-until-close (a member may edit their own response until the consultation leaves 'open' or closesAt passes). Members never read, edit, or delete other members' responses (OR RBAC owner rule). When the parent consultation's anonymousResponses is true, no view or summary displays the respondentId: it remains stored solely to enforce respond-once and edit-own (pseudonymous at display, not at rest; design D4). respondentId, submittedAt and updatedAt are server-set, never client-supplied.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: Reference to the MemberConsultation this answer belongs to. Required.

respondentId.title: Respondent
respondentId.description: Nextcloud UID of the responding member. Required and server-set (from the authenticated session, never from the client). Used to enforce respond-once and edit-own; hidden from all views/summaries when the consultation is anonymous.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: The selected option(s). Required for choice types (exactly one element for single-choice, one or more for multi-choice); empty/absent for open-text.

openText.title: Open text
openText.description: The free-text answer for an open-text consultation, or an optional remark alongside a choice.
openText.example: Mits de parkeernorm voor de binnenstad wordt verlaagd.

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: When the response was first submitted. Server-set.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the response was last edited (before close). Server-set on edit.
